facts.claim: Arabic 97:1-5 = Tanzil Uthmani v1.1 bytes, only via tanzil_97.json (sha256 in ayat[]); CC BY 3.0, verbatim, credit Tanzil Project + link

Hindi = SARAL BHAAVARTH from accepted translations (Suhel Farooq Khan, Muhammad Farooq Khan, Shaikh-ul-Hind Mahmud al-Hasan PD; English check Sahih International); nothing copied; Suhel's bracket additions not taken
Latin transliteration for the Devanagari ucharan (Tanzil ara-quran-la + quran411 ara-quran-la1); ucharan.md rows U1-U5
Name al-Qadr (honour / decree), from 'laylat al-qadr' in ayah 1; surah 97, 5 ayat, juz 30; placed right after al-'Alaq in the Mushaf

Makki per most (Mawardi 'makkiyya fi qawl al-aktharin'; Ibn al-Jawzi: Abu Salih from Ibn 'Abbas; Ibn Kathir 'makkiyya'; Tanzil/quran.com Meccan); Madani per al-Dahhak and Muqatil, Waqidi 'first surah in Madina', and al-Tha'labi says Madani is the majority view (Ibn al-Jawzi; Qurtubi's edition)
Revelation order 25 (after 'Abasa, before ash-Shams) in the Tanzil (al-Zanjani) list and quran.com - pages not opened directly today
facts.grade: maana hua (fehrist ke mutabiq; PC verify)

facts.claim: No other name of the surah found in the opened sources; use only 'Surah al-Qadr'
Main message: the greatness of the Quran and of the night it was sent down in - better than 1000 months, angels descend by Allah's permission, peace until dawn
No sahih shan-e-nuzul report exists; the reports given are mursal / gharib / without chain (N3-N5)
Quran sent down in Ramadan (2:185) in a blessed night (44:3); mufassirin link 97:1 to these; most scholars: 44:3 night = Laylat al-Qadr; first revelation came at night
Bani Israel man who carried arms (or prayed by night and fought by day) for 1000 months -> Companions amazed -> surah revealed (Ibn Abi Hatim, Ibn Jarir, al-Wahidi - all from Mujahid)
Muwatta: the Prophet was shown the lifespans of earlier nations, found his ummah's short, so Allah gave Laylat al-Qadr (Malik 'balaghahu')
1000 months = Umayyad rule (Tirmidhi from al-Hasan b. 'Ali): Tirmidhi gharib, al-Mizzi munkar, Ibn Kathir munkar jiddan
Whoever stands (in prayer) on Laylat al-Qadr with faith and hope of reward, his past sins are forgiven (Abu Hurairah)
Seek Laylat al-Qadr in the odd nights of the last ten of Ramadan (Aisha); also 'in the last ten nights' with i'tikaf
The Prophet came out to tell its date, two men were quarrelling, its knowledge was lifted, 'maybe that is better for you'; seek it on the 29th, 27th, 25th ('Ubadah b. al-Samit); quarrellers unnamed
In the last ten the Prophet tightened his waist-wrapper, kept the night alive, woke his family, strove more than at any other time (Aisha)
Sign: the next morning the sun rises without rays (Ubayy b. Ka'b); Ubayy's oath that it is the 27th is his own view
Dua taught to Aisha for Laylat al-Qadr: 'Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul 'afwa fa'fu 'anni' - most graders sahih/hasan sahih, one (Zubair 'Ali Za'i) da'if; use Ibn Majah wording without 'karim'
Which night: ~40 opinions; most: odd nights of the last ten (21/23/25/27/29), may change yearly; 27th popular (Ubayy), 21st (Abu Sa'id, Shafi'i); hidden so people strive in all
97:1 We sent it (the Quran) down in the Night of Qadr
97:2 And what will make you know what the Night of Qadr is
97:3 The Night of Qadr is better than a thousand months
97:4 The angels and the Ruh (Jibril) descend in it by their Lord's permission, for every matter
97:5 It is peace, until the rising of dawn
'hu' = the Quran though not named (honour); inna + 'We' = emphasis and greatness

Two compatible views: (a) Ibn 'Abbas: whole Quran sent at once to the lowest heaven (Bayt al-'Izzah) on this night, then in parts over years (20 or 23); (b) its sending down began on this night (Sha'bi, Ibn 'Ashur); Ibn 'Abbas report mawquf, chain grade not opened
Qadr = honour/status (Zuhri) and decree (Mujahid, Ibn Qutayba; 44:4) - both
'Wa ma adraka' = glorification, reality not easy to grasp (Ibn 'Ashur); Farra/Sufyan: where 'ma adraka' is used Allah informs (Qurtubi)
1000 months = 83 years 4 months; deeds in this night better than deeds in 1000 months without it (Tabari 'most accurate', Ibn Kathir 'huwa al-sawab'); 'thousand' also signals a very large number
Tanazzalu = angels descend in great numbers with blessing and mercy, only by Allah's permission
Ar-Ruh = Jibril per most mufassirin (Ibn al-Jawzi 'qawl al-aktharin'); other views dropped (C14)
Min kulli amr = with/for every matter Allah has decreed (the year's decrees - Qatada, Ibn 'Abbas; 44:4)
Salamun hiya = the whole night is peace and good, no evil; Shaytan cannot harm (Mujahid)
Hatta matla' al-fajr = until the first light of dawn rises (whole night)
The night was hidden so people strive in all the last ten ('maybe that is better for you')

dropped: C3 Shamsun / Ka'b king / four Israelites / Sulayman+Dhul-Qarnayn months
C6 a fixed date as certain
C9 four named angels get the decrees
C11 extra signs (dogs, sea water, lights, weather)
C17 first Madani surah as fact
C18 night lifted / whole year (madhhab debate)
C21 single tabi'i sayings on salam
